units.title: Two pigeonhole steps for same-material lighted paths
units.statement: Place n=2r+1 gates around a circle and connect every pair, with no three paths crossing at one interior point. Each of the n near-diameter chords separates the remaining gates into groups of r−1 and r and has r(r−1) distinct crossings. Among two flowerpot types, at least r(r−1)/2 pots on each such path share a type, so each is lighted at that threshold. Since these n paths use only two materials, at least r+1 lighted paths have the same material. For n=21 this yields 11.
steps: Choose a chord with nearly equal numbers of gates on both sides
Count crossing chords using one endpoint on each side
Apply pigeonhole first to flowerpot types, then to path materials
